status: frozen before any window was scored; run_study.py records this file's sha256 in results.json and refuses to run when this file changed after freeze or when the frozen inputs differ from the pins below
close_note: the tiered_tp_pct default ladder (shared_strategies/close/tiered_tp_pct.py DEFAULT_TIERS) written out explicitly, so user close defaults cannot change it; the same ladder is in the paper configurations and the Discord add path
warmup_rule: every leg (candidate arms, comparators, incumbents) computes indicators and ATR on the 300 consecutive bars before the window start and scores only the window from a flat book (eval_windows.run_leg warmup_bars); 300 exceeds the largest candidate history requirement (recursion_length 192 + 2 = 194 rows) and the 200-bar EMA of the momentum_pro incumbent; a missing pre-window bar is an error

cost_model.source: Backtester(platform='hyperliquid') defaults: Hyperliquid taker fee per side and a flat slippage per fill; the spread is not modeled separately (the flat slippage stands in for half-spread plus impact) and there is no lot-size or venue-minimum model on the M1 cached path

candle_source: binanceus spot USDT pairs (M1 non-manifest cached path), a proxy for Hyperliquid perpetual prices
funding_source: Hyperliquid fundingHistory, frozen by study chande_momentum_1661
window_notes: Study-local finite copies of the M1 windows in backtest/eval_windows.py WINDOWS; the shared M1 defaults are unchanged. is is the M1 training window. oos is the open-ended M1 window pinned to end 2026-10-01 (the frozen data end). 2023H2 replaces the M1 2023 window: the frozen candles start 2023-01-01, so 2023-01-01 has no 300-bar warmup, and Hyperliquid funding starts 2023-05-12, so held hours before it are unpriced. 2025H1a is the M1 2025H1 window cut at 2025-06-10 so it does not overlap the is training window. The five windows are disjoint. The candles were scored before by studies chande_momentum_1661, adaptive_moving_average_1641 and dual_thrust_1642 for other strategies; this candidate was never scored on them, but the held-out windows are retrospective data, not live forward evidence.
side_population_note: macd and tema_cross declare short_entries=False: their negative signal exits a long and never opens a short, so they run long-only with their registered signals. candidate_long is the candidate under the same direction, close, stop and costs; candidate_both is reported and gated separately.
grid_note: each grid is the backtest/optimizer.py DEFAULT_PARAM_RANGES entry

selection_rule.eligible: every symbol leg ran, no leg is funding-incomplete, and the three symbol legs together have at least min_training_clusters independent position clusters
selection_rule.rank: highest mean drawdown-adjusted return over the three symbol legs, then highest mean Sharpe, then the smallest parameter tuple in grid key order
selection_rule.fallback: seed parameters (candidate arms) or registry defaults (comparators) when nothing is eligible; a fallback selection is recorded and cannot support a pass

cluster_rule: positions from every symbol leg of one arm in one window are sorted by entry time; a position whose entry is at or before the latest exit of the current cluster joins it, else it starts a new cluster; partial closes of one opening event are one position

verdict_rules.scope: each timeframe group gets its own verdict over the four held-out windows; the study verdict is pass only if both groups pass, fail only if both fail, else inconclusive

evidence_gates.all_windows_scorable: every leg of every arm (and the x2 slippage candidate legs) ran and is funding-complete, and every M1 incumbent median used for the reference is funding-complete, in every held-out window
evidence_gates.selections_not_fallback: every arm was selected from eligible training rows
evidence_gates.candidate_clusters: each candidate arm has at least min_held_out_clusters independent clusters over the held-out windows
evidence_gates.both_sides: candidate_both has at least one long and one short position over the held-out windows
evidence_gates.integration_parity: parity_results.json is clean for every paper configuration run and was produced from the same frozen manifest
evidence_gates.close_capability: validate_close_capabilities reports the close owner eligible with no approximation or refusal on Hyperliquid perps

pass_conditions.candidate_both_net_positive_base: summed candidate_both net PnL after fees and funding over every held-out leg > 0
pass_conditions.candidate_long_net_positive_base: summed candidate_long net PnL over every held-out leg > 0
pass_conditions.candidate_long_beats_macd_sharpe: candidate_long mean Sharpe over every held-out leg > macd mean Sharpe over the same legs

verdict_rules.fail: every evidence gate is true and any pass condition is false
verdict_rules.pass: every evidence gate and every pass condition is true
verdict_rules.descriptive_only: the M1 incumbent-relative verdict per window, concentration (largest position share of positive position PnL), turnover, fees, funding, parameter stability, unsuccessful variants and the continuous-history reference are reported and never change the verdict
verdict_rules.edge_effect: every outcome keeps edge_status no_edge; pass keeps edge_source unvalidated pending a separate reviewed edge decision, fail records study_fail, inconclusive records study_inconclusive

continuous_reference.label: continuous-history TRIX (all three EMAs and the signal line seeded once at the first bar of the warmed leg frame and never restarted); a descriptive reference only, it never makes a decision
continuous_reference.compare: on every held-out window bar of every symbol and group, with the selected candidate_both parameters: max and median absolute oscillator and signal-line difference, and the count of bars whose entry decision differs

limitations: Binance US spot candles stand in for Hyperliquid perpetual prices; proxy results cannot establish Hyperliquid profitability or venue execution parity.
Costs are the Backtester Hyperliquid taker fee (0.045% per side) and a flat 0.05% slippage per fill; the spread is not modeled separately and there is no lot-size or venue-minimum model on this path.
Funding is charged from frozen Hyperliquid rates (--funding charge); a leg with unpriced held hours is incomplete and cannot count as economic evidence.
No venue execution manifest is used; the frozen offline manifest path (fees, spread, slippage, lots and minimums) is available in eval_windows.py but this study does not include venue evidence.
